summary: Finished the export command: implemented --where evaluation, locale date/datetime patterns and group_sizes/min_grouping grouping, spec-exact CSV quoting with CRLF, null placement independent of direction, .slice-NNN file naming, and made the store reader split lines on newline only. One existing test (tests/test_export.py test_split_into_files) still expects the old people-001.csv naming, which contradicts spec section 10.3; I followed the spec and did not touch the tests.
